description.p: A faceted gem that hums with stored magic. While you have it equipped, you gain one additional 1st-level spell slot. When you equip the gem, choose which of your spellcasting classes the slot belongs to; it recharges with that class's other slots.
Warlocks use a Renewal Charm (Pact Magic) instead.
